name: Corto 3D cinematográfico (personajes realistas)
source: Referencia del dueño (YouTube 7rd6HWqvaHQ), estudiada el 2026-10-23 con Gemini; solo se guarda cómo está hecha.
grade: Warm, bright tones for daytime construction, slightly cooler/moodier for the bar and night scenes, with a greenish tint and chromatic aberration for the time-rewind effect. Red hues for moments of danger or intense emotion.
typography: Simple, clean white text for 'Zack D. Mart' and 'Zack D. Pop' on products. Dartboard text for scores and rules.
narration: Male voice, calm, descriptive, omniscient, guiding the narrative.
music: Uplifting, slightly dramatic background music. Realistic foley sounds for all actions (shoveling, touching, breaking glass, pouring drinks, footsteps, car sounds, gunshots, etc.). Distinct 'rewind' sound effect with a high-pitched whirring. Dialogue is minimal, mostly background chatter or brief exclamations.
effects: Time rewind visual distortion (chromatic aberration, blur, speed lines)
look: Cinematic 3D short film: near-photoreal characters, warm day / cool night grade, close-ups on faces and the key object, tracking, dolly and crane moves, whip pans; one signature visual effect that recurs (chromatic aberration, blur, speed lines) with its own sound.
camera: Frequent use of close-ups on faces and objects (especially the dial), dynamic tracking shots, wide establishing shots, low-angle shots, high-angle shots, whip pans, dolly shots, crane shots, mimicking handheld camera work to enhance realism and immersion.
humans: Highly realistic, near photorealistic, but still identifiable as 3D animation due to subtle uncanny valley effects in movement and facial expressions.
viral: Humorous and dramatic situations created by the time-rewind power
Clear narrative progression with escalating stakes
Satisfying visual and sound effects for the time manipulation
